title: Kissed Mediterranean Eggplant Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic stew originating from North Africa, made with tender eggplant, kissed with a hint of sweetness and spices.
instructions: Heat kissed Mediterranean olive oil in a large clay tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add sliced eggplant and cook until it starts to soften, about 5 minutes.
Stir in cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add tagine spice mix and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Cover the tagine and simmer over low heat for 20-25 minutes, or until the eggplant is tender.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
